title: Enemy floats in mid-air defying gravity (floating_enemy)
explanation: At frame 896, FloatingEnemy walks off the ledge at position (7200, 550) without falling, triggering bug_trigger 2B. In Enemy.gd:L36-L47, velocity.y is forcibly zeroed when is_floating_bug is active and the enemy is not on the floor, instead of applying gravity via super._physics_process. This violates the physical kinematic invariant that unsupported airborne entities must accelerate downward under gravity.
